update.safe_clean: Safe: no conflicts with your changes
update.safe_clean_desc: A backup is made before installing; if the shell fails to start, everything rolls back by itself.
update.safe_drift: Installed files were edited by hand
update.safe_drift_desc: Installing will overwrite them with the repository version. A backup is made first.
update.safe_hook: The new tabs' hooks will be re-applied automatically
update.safe_hook_desc: The conflict is only in the lines that attach the tabs; they are restored by anchors.
update.safe_repo: The repository is not ready for an update
update.safe_repo_desc: Switch to branch {branch} and commit local changes.
update.safe_conflict_desc: The update will not be installed until the conflict is resolved. Nothing was changed.
update.older_desc: Pick a version to read the list of its changes
update.translated_note: Translated by Gemini. The original is shown if the translation is unavailable.
update.hint_health: rolls back automatically if it fails
update.dont_poweroff: Do not turn off the computer until it finishes
update.done_desc: The shell was restarted · your changes are in place
update.err_title_rollback: The shell did not start — automatic rollback done
update.err_rollback_desc: You are on the previous version {v}. Nothing was lost.

err.repo_missing: The repository with your changes was not found.
err.wrong_remote: The repository has an unexpected origin URL.
err.wrong_branch: The repository is not on the working branch serp-x.
err.merge_in_progress: The repository has an unfinished merge.
err.install_missing: The install directory was not found.
err.drift: Installed files differ from the repository.
err.fetch_failed: Could not download the changes (no network?).
err.merge_conflict: Conflict with your changes in: {files}. Nothing was changed.
err.hook_missing: The tab hooks disappeared after the merge and could not be restored.
err.custom_incomplete: Files of our custom features are missing after the merge. Update cancelled, nothing was installed.
err.backup_failed: Could not make a backup. Nothing was installed.
err.sync_failed: Could not copy the files, rolled back.
err.health_failed: The shell did not start ({detail}), rolled back.
